maria_cs: Hey team — FjordApps onboarding check. Noticed p95 latency on /v1/generate jumped to ~420ms this morning, their SLA target is <150ms. Renewal in ~6 weeks, want to proactively nudge with perf options.
aj_dev: thanks for flagging. quick Q — are they on our Dedicated fleet or hosted?
maria_cs: Dedicated (us-east). No recent model changes from their side. They have a lot of repeated prefix prompts (chatbot).
kevin_support: I pulled traces — KV cache hit rate is 12%, request sizes vary a lot, a few long-context bursts. Routing is single-region eu-fallback off.
aj_dev: two concrete moves: 1) try an int8 quantized variant to cut token cost and CPU overhead; 2) intelligent routing policy to route short requests to a smaller faster model and long-context to bigger instance.
maria_cs: can you give a one-pager config I can share with the customer and PS team? they want low friction changes.
aj_dev: small snippet for their infra team to test as a canary:
```
{
  "model": "rdx-2x-q8",
  "routing_policy": "latency_then_cost",
  "split_by": "prompt_length",
  "split_threshold": 256,
  "cache_prefix": true,
  "canary_pct": 5
}
```
kevin_support: add rollout guard: monitor p95 and a small eval set for quality. auto-rollback if p95 > 1.2x baseline OR quality drop (exact-match) > 2%. Also tag requests with `fjord-onboard` for observability.
maria_cs: they approved 5% canary. I'll run an enablement call tonight and send the eval prompts.
aj_dev: i'll open infra ticket to prepare rdx-2x-q8 on their Dedicated pool and add routing rule, will include a healthcheck script.
kevin_support: noted. also recommending prefix cache tuning: set prefix window to 512 tokens and aggressive cache TTL for repeated sessions. Should help hit rate quickly.
maria_cs: perfect — I'll capture feedback during the call and route any quality concerns back here. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for fjordapps -> rdx-2x-q8 (5%) at 2034567920
maria_cs: logging this as proactive optimization for renewal playbook. Follow up post-canary.
